notes.title: Brazilian Portuguese is now available!
notes.notes: The game has been updated with Brazilian Portuguese and other small optimizations. This is likely the last update the game will receive unless there's bugs/issues folks find, or unless someone does a translation for me. (I cannot afford to keep getting translations for this game, sorry!) Thanks for your support everyone!
